# Step 1 — create seed (`demo/1-seed`)

**Open:** `docs/implementation-plans/plan-seeds/due-dates.md`

**Decision to explain:** the seed carries the outcome, scope, allowed changes
and reorganization, verification, and stop rules. Read Risks, Testing, and
Acceptance criteria to see what preparation can carry forward. Correct the
seed or approve plan creation.

**Live version:** a seed is authored with an assistant, not generated by a
plan-tool verb. Ask your coding assistant:

> Use the installed plan-tool skill to inspect this repository and draft
> `docs/implementation-plans/plan-seeds/due-dates.md`. Tasks gain an optional
> due date and `todo list --overdue` shows open tasks past due. Cite the files
> you check, keep the scope explicit, and wait for my review before committing
> the seed and running create.

**Baked state:** this branch already contains the reviewed seed.
**Next:** `./step.sh next`
